cohort: Women residing in Kharak village under PHC, Fatehpur Beri in South Delhi who delivered between 2007 and 2016.
finding: The proportion of institutional deliveries increased significantly from 23% in 2007-2012 to 42% in 2012-2016, and assistance by trained health professionals also increased significantly from 26% to 44% between these periods.
mod_finding: The proportion of cesarean section deliveries did not differ significantly between the two study periods.
